hits.title: FriskAI raises $3.6M from MaC Venture Capital to watch what AI agents do — TFN
hits.snippet: - FriskAI emerged from stealth with $3.6 million in pre-seed funding to track what AI agents do once deployed. - MaC Venture Capital led the round, targeting the healthcare, insurance, and finance sectors. - It joins a field that has raised over $175 million in 2026 alone. Enterprises have spent the past year handing AI agents access to their databases, internal tools, and customer systems. Almost none of them can say with confidence what those agents actually did with it. [FriskAI](https://www.friskai.com/) wants to close that gap, and it has raised $3.6 million in pre-seed funding to build the tooling to do so. MaC Venture Capital, which has backed companies including Pipe, Blavity and IronVest, led the round, joined by Wischoff Ventures, NEA partner [Rick Yang](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rickcyang) and a group of strategic angel investors. “Companies can monitor servers, applications, and employees, but they lack runtime intelligence for AI agents,” [said Neel Palrecha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/npalrecha/), FriskAI’s founder and chief executive. ## Making AI agents visible in production Palrecha founded FriskAI in 2025 in Los Angeles, after years shipping production systems

hits.snippet: As AI agents move from experimentation into real-world enterprise workflows, visibility and trust become critical. We’re excited to lead the $3.6M pre-seed round in FriskAI, which is building the runtime intelligence layer enterprises need to understand what AI agents are actually doing once deployed. As our Managing Partner Marlon Nichols shared, every major technology cycle creates foundational infrastructure companies that the rest of the ecosystem comes to depend on. We believe AI agents represent the next major cycle and trust will be essential to unlocking their potential. Congratulations to Neel Palrecha and the entire FriskAI team on emerging from stealth.
